item.title: Why Are JavaScript Global Variables Discouraged and How Can We Safely Structure Code
item.description:
“Why Are JavaScript Global Variables Discouraged and How Can We Safely Structure Code”

A significant challenge in JavaScript development, particularly in larger applications or when integrating multiple scripts, revolves around the pervasive nature of global variables. Why are these seemingly convenient variables often cited as detrimental to code quality, and what established patterns mitigate these risks while maintaining necessary accessibility?

The core issue stems from JavaScript’s single global namespace. Any variable inadvertently declared outside a local scope—or variables not explicitly declared using var, let, or const (implied globals)—are automatically hoisted into this shared space. This practice invites severe namespace collisions across different scripts residing on the same page, leading to unpredictable behavior, as noted by experts like Douglas Crockford.
